findings.passage: The SAVE Act would establish a uniform standard by requiring documentary proof of citizenship when registering to vote in federal elections.
findings.note: In a signed campaign-site piece, he describes the federal SAVE Act as setting one standard of documentary proof of citizenship at registration for federal elections.

findings.passage: The SAVE Act addresses that balance by relying on documentation that citizens already possess, such as a passport, a birth certificate, or other official records demonstrating citizenship.
findings.note: He says the proof-of-citizenship requirement uses documents citizens already have, and presents it as balancing access with integrity.

findings.passage: South Carolina requires identification at the polls and has built a reputation for orderly election administration.
findings.note: He refers to South Carolina's in-person ID rule as the model the federal bill builds on.

findings.passage: It would also require election officials to maintain procedures that verify voter eligibility against existing records.
findings.note: He describes the bill's voter-roll eligibility checks against existing records.
